### Read JSON File with Bun

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/read-file/json.mdx

Reads a JSON file from the specified path and parses its content into a JavaScript object using `Bun.file().json()`. The `BunFile` instance automatically sets the correct MIME type.

```ts
const path = "/path/to/package.json";
const file = Bun.file(path);

const contents = await file.json();
// { name: "my-package" }

file.type; // => "application/json;charset=utf-8";
```

### Read Stdin Chunks with `Bun.stdin.stream()` in Bun

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/process/stdin.mdx

Utilize `Bun.stdin.stream()` to read large inputs piped into the Bun process as `Uint8Array` chunks. Chunks are not guaranteed to be split by line.

```ts
for await (const chunk of Bun.stdin.stream()) {
  // chunk is Uint8Array
  // this converts it to text (assumes ASCII encoding)
  const chunkText = Buffer.from(chunk).toString();
  console.log(`Chunk: ${chunkText}`);
}
```

### Pipe Input to `Bun.stdin.stream()` Example

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/process/stdin.mdx

Demonstrates how to pipe text input to a Bun script that uses `Bun.stdin.stream()` to process the input.

```sh
echo "hello" | bun run stdin.ts
```

### Read from stdin

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/process/stdin.mdx

Bun provides `Bun.stdin` as a `BunFile` object, which can be used to incrementally read large inputs that are piped into the `bun` process.

--------------------------------

### Convert a ReadableStream to JSON

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/streams/to-json.mdx

Bun provides several conveniences for reading the contents of a ReadableStream into other formats. To read a stream and parse it as JSON, call its json() method.
